resources.string: You need your own account and an original copy of the game. You sign in on the official website, in your browser. HyPocket never asks for your password.
Sign-in is not available yet. HyPocket is waiting for official access from Hypixel Studios.
Open the sign-in page and enter this code:
This account does not own the game.
The game license could not be checked yet.
The code expired. Please try again.
The account service returned an error.
Could not connect. Check your internet connection.
Sign in with an account that owns the game to download and play.
Downloading the game is not available yet.
This phone is not supported. HyPocket needs an ARM64 processor.
The game engine is not ready yet.
Unofficial project, not affiliated with Hypixel Studios.
Runs a small x86-64 test program through the Box64 translator and compares it with the same work done natively. It does not use any game files.
Passed: the translated program gave the correct result.
Wrong result: the translated program finished, but its result is different.
Failed: the translated program did not finish correctly.
Timed out: the translated program took too long.
Blocked: Android stopped the translator because it used a system call apps are not allowed to use.
The translator is not available on this device.
Runs a small x86-64 OpenGL ES test program through the translator. It draws a triangle off screen with your phone\'s GPU and checks the colors. It does not use any game files.
Passed: the triangle was drawn with the right colors.
Wrong result: the drawing finished, but the colors are wrong.
Failed: the graphics server did not start.
Drawn correctly, but the desktop OpenGL version is below the 4.1 the game needs.
Shows an animated scene drawn by an x86-64 test program with your phone\'s GPU, using desktop OpenGL 4.1. It runs for 15 seconds and does not use any game files.
Done: the scene was drawn and shown.
Drawn by the test program (can be above the screen\'s refresh rate): %1$.1f fps
Per frame: draw %1$.1f ms, copy %2$.1f ms

Draws a block terrain with textures and lighting at 50%, 75% and 100% of your screen\'s resolution, with three amounts of blocks, and measures the time per frame. Takes about 30 seconds and does not use any game files.
If the app closed by itself during a test, open it again and tap this button. It copies why the system says the app ended (crash, low memory…) so you can paste it in your report.
Checks that this phone can keep your sign-in encrypted with the Android Keystore. It uses made-up data, not your account.
Passed: the sign-in can be saved encrypted on this phone.
Failed: the saved data could not be read back.
Failed: the data was not encrypted.
Failed: the Android Keystore gave an error.
This phone has no OpenGL ES 3 driver, which the game needs.
This phone\'s OpenGL ES version is too old for the game. It needs 3.2.
This phone has OpenGL ES 3.1. The game needs 3.2 to run well; it might still work, but it has not been tested.
This phone has little memory. The game may close or run slowly; close other apps before playing.
Download the game on Wi-Fi only
The game is downloaded from the official servers with your account. If the download stops, it continues from where it stopped.
Connect to Wi-Fi to download, or turn off “Download the game on Wi-Fi only” in Settings.
Not enough free space: the download needs %1$d MB and the phone has %2$d MB free.
The download stopped: check your internet connection and try again. It continues from where it stopped.
A downloaded file was damaged and was deleted. Try again.
The game servers did not answer correctly. Try again later.
The file could not be saved on the phone. Check the free space and try again.
Copies how much memory the phone has free right now, and how much HyPocket uses. Android does not let apps see other apps, so it only shows totals.
The same test, but the frames go straight from the GPU to the screen, without the copy back to the test program. Experimental. If the screen stays black, send the report.

A small block world made for HyPocket, open source and not related to any other game. It runs through the same path as a real game (x86-64 translator, desktop OpenGL and the direct display), so it shows how the phone handles a game-like load. Plays sound, and works with touch, game controllers and keyboards. Uses the render scale and FPS limit above. Leaving the screen ends the session.
Left: walk · Right: drag to look, tap to break
The game ran and closed normally.
Left stick: walk · Right stick: look · A: jump · X/RT: break · B/LT: place · Start: exit
Dynamic resolution: lower the 3D resolution while the GPU cannot keep up (test game only for now)
